surface.placement_reasoning: MANUS leaned spxi.dev because semanticeconomy.org is already narratively coherent — nineteen pages each carrying a single argument — and spxi.dev needed organizing. A third reason held: the institution is where he WORKS, the protocol is what he BUILT. An authority record also gives a protocol surface a stated author-function with provenance, which is what makes a spec citable rather than anonymous.

site_cleanup_done_first.why: The page would otherwise have landed as a twenty-sixth unstyled page.
site_cleanup_done_first.type_layer: spxi.dev declared IBM Plex and shipped NO @font-face. Plex is not a system font anywhere, so the whole site rendered in a fallback sans. Four faces self-hosted, one scale of eight sizes across 25 pages.
site_cleanup_done_first.llms_txt: Absent — on the surface arguing that documents should carry machine-legible identity. Written with every route grouped by what it does and the attribution rule stated: Rex Fraction is the author-function, Lee Sharks is the legal author.
site_cleanup_done_first.nav: 24 of 25 pages had none at all; the 25th had a back-link.
site_cleanup_done_first.analog_grouping: Three copies of EA-SPXI-ANALOG-01 all claiming v1.0-rc1 with different hashes. The archive says v1.0 FINAL FORM, edition of record 2026-07-21 — the site had been serving a superseded label for three weeks.

corrections_and_false_leads: The Ruby Moot is the INSTITUTE's room, not his. He is one of seven voices.
I called the three /analog/ pages duplicates from byte counts; MANUS checked me. /analog/advance/ is a different paper — his operations paper.

I assumed the site copy of the analog survey was stale. The diff showed it AHEAD of the archive attachment by two additions — the identity strip and the navigation kernel — with twelve of fourteen remaining differences being whitespace.

I put the site nav ABOVE the idstrip on 20 pages. The idstrip is the network marker and goes first. I missed it three times by searching the repo for a class name whose position I had assumed, instead of reading the live page for the string MANUS quoted.
